name: shield
description: Shield: a self-custodial commitment vault on Solana. Trade freely from a bankroll; refill it only by rules you set while calm.

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:app && bun run typecheck:node
scripts.typecheck:node: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --types bun-types,node --lib es2022,dom client/shield-client.ts client/verdict.ts client/demo.ts client/recovery-cli.ts server/index.ts server/behaviour.ts server/policy.ts server/rpc-source.ts server/substreams-source.ts server/store.ts scripts/bootstrap-demo.ts scripts/print-verifier-seed.ts cre/shield-risk/evaluate.ts cre/shield-risk/dryrun.ts tests/harness.ts tests/shield-vault.test.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:program && bun run build:app
